text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hold the hell up! 
What d'you mean, "canceled"?! Hey!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Strictly speaking, we are at the stage of 
"considering cancellation." 
Unfortunately, circumstances are strongly 
pointing in that direction.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
It appears the vendor we commissioned for 
the equipment ran into major trouble. 
...One can only describe it as 
unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A lot of the staging equipment was 
custom-made, so there are no replacements 
available. 
Rescheduling or securing alternatives 
before the Fan Appreciation Festival... 
looks to be very difficult.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then... does that mean we can still do it 
if we change the staging plan? 
If we go without the large-scale lighting 
and special equipment—

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
I, too, want nothing more than to see it 
happen. 
However—that is not the only reason.

text_block_list.name: Weather Forecaster
text_block_list.text:
"This low-pressure system is expected to 
develop rapidly starting late next week, 
and is projected to affect vast regions 
across the country, with the exception of 
Kanto."

text_block_list.name: Weather Forecaster
text_block_list.text:
"The system is anticipated to pack winds 
equivalent to a major typhoon, 
with impacts on public transit already 
expected nationwide—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...I seeee. A lot of folks travel from out 
of town for the Festival, after all. 
Looking at the forecasts, flights 
especially seem like they'll take a 
massive hit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It is virtually certain that visitors from 
distant regions will decrease 
significantly. 
Under such circumstances, if equipment 
troubles also prevent us from delivering a 
flawless parade—

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
The illuminated parade is the very 
centerpiece of this year's Festival. 
If we are to host it, we owe it to the 
fans to deliver the absolute best 
performance possible.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Festival Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
As such, wouldn't it be far better for the 
fans if we properly prepared and held it 
next year instead? 
...That is the committee's current 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't officially been canceled yet, 
though, 
so I really wish there was something we 
could do...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even if we change the plan now, how much 
can we really pull off? 
Judging from their tone... they probably 
won't let us proceed with just a 
scaled-down version.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, to think the parade's getting 
canceled over equipment trouble...

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame... b-but the weather's 
terrible anyway, so my hometown friends 
probably couldn't have made it either... 
Maybe it's for the best if I just give 
up...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...It ain't set in stone yet, damn it. 
Wipe that pathetic look off your faces.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...If it gets canceled, I won't be able 
to keep my promise to Mom. 
The parade that was supposed to make a 
lasting memory for her will be gone.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...As long as the parade happens, at 
least she can see the recording of it. 
Cancellation is... not an option...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I am not giving up. No freaking way...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. 
Giving up just isn't like you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Those guys have reasons they wanna try 
hard for too, or someone they wanna 
impress. 
...Someone they want to make smile.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: If we give up, nobody ends up happy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Rickey-chan. 
What's got you looking so serious?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was just checking what people are 
saying on social media about the Festival.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I'll have to settle for the 
livestream this year..." "I really wanted 
to see the parade in person, though." 
Everyone sounds so disappointed after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why—that's exactly why I want to 
make sure this parade happens, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And not just that—I want to make it a 
parade that brings the ultimate happiness 
to everyone, whether they can come in 
person or not!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Rickey-chan. 
Reach your hand out. Come on, like this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See, this is as far as our hands can 
reach. It's not infinite. 
Trying to reach out to everything... isn't 
easy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If you reach out too far and come up 
short... the regret stays with you for a 
long time. 
I've seen that happen way too many times 
before, so... I can't help but worry a 
little, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If we do this, we can reach so much 
further. 
Just like how Espo-san is pulling everyone 
forward by the hand right now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I... don't want to leave a single person 
behind. 
Sure, maybe I can't do it alone. But—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If we overcome the walls in our hearts, 
face each other directly—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And team up with everyone in the parade 
crew we've connected with along the 
way...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—We can reach out even farther and spread 
even more happiness! 
If we run ahead and take their hands, we 
can definitely connect with anyone, 
anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just like how you were able to connect 
with way more people than before, 
Espo-san! 
If we do that, even the things we thought 
were impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—...!  
............I see. Okay, yeah, gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is... nah, this is what Ricky-chan is 
all about, huh? 
I like it. Feels like we just unlocked a 
super secret route.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Ricky-chan. We still have a 
whole week left.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In fact... wouldn't this be the perfect 
way to get a flawless 100% clear with zero 
misses? 
...Plus, hearing all that gave me a little 
idea I kinda wanna explore.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san...! 
That's right! Let's make one! A brand-new 
parade plan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One that connects us with the people who 
couldn't make it—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A new form of parade, you say?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Tran-san and I pulled an all-nighter 
brainstorming, and we finally found it! 
With this, we can definitely break through 
this crisis!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Allow us to explain...! 
The fruit of our sleep-deprived labor—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
The "Dreamy Night Parade Connecting 
Everyone"...!
